notes.subject: a ye aw ka ɲɛgɛn bɔ
notes.rationale: ויזנב literally 'he cut off your tail (zanav)' — a tail-picture verb; rendered 'cut off your rear ones', the picture is kept but the tail-word is not Bamanankan-idiomatic.

notes.subject: הנחשלים
notes.rationale: Rare passive participle 'the weakened/limping ones', occurring only here — kept as 'nɔgɔyala' (weak ones).

notes.subject: Elohim
notes.rationale: 'He did not fear Elohim' — some read Elohim here as 'God', some ancient versions as 'you showed no fear of God'; name kept untranslated.

notes.subject: קרך
notes.rationale: Root קרה 'happen upon' also evokes קר 'cold' in rabbinic reading (they cooled you toward heaven) — wordplay untranslatable here.

translation: Min i bɛn aw la sira la, a ye aw ka ɲɛgɛn bɔ — o bɛɛ minnu tun ye nɔgɔyala — aw kɔfɛ, ka ɔ fɔ aw tun ye maayalenw ni lasaralenw, nka a ma Elohim siran.
